title: Invertibility of the normalized closed mate for pro-etale restriction
statement: Let X,U,O,B,c,delta,S,SR,SB,T,TR,TB be the coefficient slice data [def-zl-proetale-slice-comparison-data]. For any TensorData d satisfying TensorNormalized, the transpose under SR of the inverse normalized restriction tensor comparison followed by restriction of S.evaluation(L,M) is an isomorphism for all ordinary unbounded derived O-modules L,M. This concerns only sectionwise restriction r:D(O)→D(O|U); scalar transport and pullback Hom maps are not asserted.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 08J9, 08JB and 0FPT; normalized slice comparison in Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach Lemma 4.5.

proof.text: Identify U_proet with the literal slice site by the canonical site equivalence. Restriction preserves K-injectivity, and the local Hom families on further slices and their product differentials are unchanged. Thus the unbounded internal-Hom comparison is invertible.

The pure-tensor formula and exact localization square identify d.restrictionTensor.rho with the canonical slice tensor map on K-flat representatives. The slice evaluation equation identifies the invertible Hom map with the displayed transpose. Injectivity of the closed Hom bijection gives equality, and hence invertibility of that mate.

theorem proEtaleSlice_closed_maps_isIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.ProEt)
    (O : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U.left) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage U.hom CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj O ≅ B)
    (delta : ProEtaleObjectRestrictionComparison U CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (proEtaleCoefficientHom X O))
    (SR : CoefficientClosedStructure (proEtaleCoefficientHom U.left (proEtaleSliceRing U O)))
    (SB : CoefficientClosedStructure (proEtaleCoefficientHom U.left B))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X) O S)
    (TR : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology U.left)
      (proEtaleSliceRing U O) SR)
    (TB : CoefficientTensorModels.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology U.left) B SB)
    (d : ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.TensorData U O B c delta S SR SB T TR TB)
    (hd : ProEtaleCoefficientSliceComparison.TensorNormalized
      U O B c delta S SR SB T TR TB d) :
    ∀ L M : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X O),
      IsIso (coefficientClosedPullbackMap S SR
        (proEtaleSliceModuleRestriction U O).mapDerivedCategory
          d.restrictionTensor.rho L M)
